description: GeoNuclearData is a worldwide nuclear-reactor inventory maintained by Cristian Stoica. It contains approximate coordinates, reactor type, status, capacity and construction or operating dates, assembled mainly from WNA and IAEA sources with supplementary corrections. The README reports 804 reactors for its March 2024 data update; this is not a current operating-reactor count. MySQL, JSON and CSV representations support database and spatial analysis. The database is free under ODbL-1.0, with DBCL-1.0 applying to individual contents. A limitation is disagreement between source status categories and reactor names. Coordinates are approximate and may be especially misleading for floating plants. Maintenance identifiers and timestamps are explicitly not recommended as analytical fields. The inventory can support nuclear-generation capacity scenarios and preliminary infrastructure exposure analysis. The Global Power Plant Database (data-global-power-plant-database) offers related generation-asset coverage. No reactor table was downloaded or its coordinates independently checked.
